items.Sentence: Until then, the effluent limitation applies at the southeast corner of evaporation/percolation Pond 6.
Instead of the minimum setback distance of 50 feet listed in the General Order, the Discharger proposed a minimum setback distance of 31 feet for the proposed evaporation ponds.
